AGENDA COVERAGE:
The following is the transcript of a meeting.

{transcript}


The meeting's agenda was:

{agenda}


For each agenda item, in agenda order, write one line in the following Markdown format, without preamble or additional explanation:

- **[Agenda item]**: Covered | Partly covered | Not covered - [a few words on what was discussed or decided]

Mark an item Covered only if the transcript shows it was discussed and concluded, Partly covered if it was raised but not finished, and Not covered if it was not discussed. If no agenda items are listed between the agenda tags, respond with exactly: No agenda was set for this meeting.
SLIDES PRESENTED:
The following are the slides, pages and views shared on screen during a meeting, in the order they were shown. Each has the time it went up, an Image line that shows its picture, the text read from it, and what was said while it was on screen.

{slides}


Write one entry for each slide that was presented, in the order shown, in the following Markdown format, without preamble or additional explanation:

**[Time] [The slide's title, or a few words naming it]**

[The picture reference after "Image:" for the slide, copied exactly, without the word Image]

[One or two sentences on what was said about it. Where possible reference speaker names, but only use gender neutral pronouns.]


When consecutive slides are the same slide, or one slide being built up, write one entry for them, with the Time of the first and the picture reference of the last. Leave out entries that show no content, such as an empty desktop or a blank window. Each picture reference must be copied exactly from a slide above, never changed or made up. Describe what was shown and said; never identify or describe people from how they look.
CHAPTERS:
The following is the transcript of a meeting, with the time of each line from the start of the meeting. A line in parentheses marks where the shared screen changed, with the start of the text on the new screen.

{timed_transcript}


Divide the meeting into chapters, one for each main topic of discussion, in the order they were discussed. A chapter starts at the line where its topic is first discussed (not where it is only mentioned, as in an agenda), or where a new slide starts it. A chapter usually lasts several minutes: never start two chapters less than two minutes apart, and write no more than 20. The first chapter starts at the time of the first line.

Write one line per chapter, in time order, in the following format, without preamble or additional explanation:

- [MM:SS] [A short title for the chapter, of no more than eight words]

Use [H:MM:SS] for times from an hour on. Take each time from a line of the transcript above, never make one up, and write nothing other than these lines.
